issues.title: Crash when sharing artist from artist detail page [java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: invalid beforeContentPadding]
issues.notes: Top candidate of the 2026-09-02 run; did not clear the 80 gate (66/100). Code located exactly: ArtistScreen.kt:273-282 is the only negative window-inset contentPadding in app/src (multiline grep), and the issue is specifically the artist detail page. Corroborated by #922 (different reporter, version 0.10.0-b5 vs 0.9.3.1, identical exception). Localization capped at 12 because the mechanism is unproven: playerAwareWindowInsets (MainActivity.kt:526-545) supplies systemBarsIgnoringVisibility.top + AppBarHeight, ArtistScreen subtracts systemBars.top + AppBarHeight, so the sum is systemBarsIgnoringVisibility.top - systemBars.top, which is >= 0 by definition and evaluates to exactly 0 px at the reporter's density (88 + 168 - 256 = 0 at 2.625). Nothing I could establish explains it going negative, so a coerceAtLeast(0.dp) clamp would be a symptom fix -> Phase 3 self-review would fail. Diagnostic held at 14 (exact error string + full logcat) rather than 20: the stack trace contains no app class, only Compose/framework frames. Verifiability 5 because build_capability is none and this is runtime-only Compose layout.

issues.title: Playing downloaded song from artist page fetches the song online instead of locally
issues.notes: Top candidate of the 2026-09-01 run. Real defect confirmed in MusicService.kt:createDataSourceFactory (queue-supplied SongItem.toMediaMetadata() never carries isLocal/localPath, so the DB fallback never runs). Confidently explains the custom/external-download failure mode; does not confidently explain the internal-download failure mode the reporter also describes (that path uses downloadCache.isCached() by mediaId, independent of queue metadata). No logs/stack trace/viewable recording. Did not clear the 80 gate (55/100).

issues.title: Authentication Tokens Stored in Plaintext
issues.notes: Hard abort: fix needs either a new dependency (androidx.security-crypto, requires editing gradle/libs.versions.toml - forbidden) or touching ~10 call sites with no shared token accessor plus a migration for existing plaintext values, well past blast-radius limits. Precisely localized (PreferenceKeys.kt:204-208, DataStore.kt:24) but blocked on scope, not evidence.

issues.title: Searching "null" results in a crash
issues.notes: Already fixed in this fork. Verified directly: MainActivity.kt:730-733 declares the search route's query nav arg nullable=true, and OnlineSearchViewModel.kt:27 recovers via `?: "null"` instead of `!!`. LocalSearchViewModel.kt never routes through nav args at all, so it was never exposed either.
